title: Metadata does not get exported
body: ### Bug description I fill the metadata in Audacity 4, as I did in Audacity 3, but it does not get recognized when i import the song to Music-App in MacOS. If I do this in Audacity 3, it works well, that is, the metadata is in the song and imported to Music-App in MacOS. ### Steps to reproduce 1. record a song 2. try to export song 3. fill in the metadata 4. import exported song to Music-App in MacOS 5. the metadata is not recognized in Music-App., it is empty ### Expected behavior 1-4. same as above 5. the metadata is recognized in Music-App. ### Actual behavior _No response_ ### Audacity Version Audacity 4.0.1 ### Operating system macOS ### Additional context _No response_
